def: A check outside the main model that inspects an input, retrieved text, an answer or an action and allows, blocks, rewrites or escalates it.
The written statement of what a system may and may not say or do, with examples and an action for each category.
A guardrail that inspects the user's message before the model sees it.
A guardrail that inspects the model's draft answer before the user sees it.
A guardrail that inspects a proposed tool call and its arguments before it runs, often as an exact rule in code.
Of the inputs the policy says must be caught, the share the guardrail actually caught.
Blocking or refusing a legitimate request because it resembles a prohibited one.
A language model fine-tuned to classify prompts and responses against a list of safety categories, such as Llama Guard.
Data that identifies a person or can be linked to one, such as names, email addresses, phone numbers and card numbers.
A checksum that payment card numbers satisfy, used to discard digit strings that merely look like card numbers.
Replacing each personal value with a consistent placeholder while keeping the mapping separately so it can be reversed.
Stopping the request when a safety check errors or times out, instead of letting it pass.
